title: Interior and Inventory
author: Kestrel Thackeray
blurb: Casper Brightwater, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
